meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会进入“超工作模式”，强制先输出“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”，然后严格按规则执行：先调查、再规划、再编码，每一步都要记录证据，最后通过真实测试验证。
howto.when: 当你的提示词中包含“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式，帮我修复这个 bug。
say.note: Claude 会启动超工作模式，按规则逐步修复。

say.text: ulw，写一个用户注册的 API 端点。
say.note: Claude 会先调查现有代码，再规划并实现。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude enters 'ultrawork mode', first outputs 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!', then strictly follows rules: survey, plan, code, capture evidence, and verify with real-surface tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when your prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and fix this bug.
